The season that comes after autumn is winter.

The author's narrative style in the provided text is characterized by a third-person objective point of view. The narrator observes the detective's actions and speech without entering his internal thoughts or offering personal judgment, instead reporting on the observable qualities of his narration, such as his "meticulous attention to detail" and "clinical detachment." The tone of the text is analytical and appreciative yet restrained. It maintains a formal and detached atmosphere, mirroring the subject matter by focusing on the structural and stylistic elements of the detective's storytelling rather than the emotional content of the events themselves. The language is precise and unembellished, reinforcing the sense of clinical observation.
